specific_explanation: The payload contains UNION SELECT style syntax, commonly used to merge attacker queries with application queries.
This often indicates an attempt to extract additional database rows or columns.
Weak matched indicators: select_keyword, union_keyword, comment_end

meta.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT; Windows NT 10.0; en-US) WindowsPowerShell/5.1.26100.8894

summary.message: SQLi detected with subtype: UNION-based SQLi

possible_impact: Authentication bypass, unauthorized data access, or database fingerprinting.
Potential data extraction, modification, or destruction depending on permissions.

attack_preconditions: User-controlled input reaches an SQL context without proper parameter binding.
The backend query construction allows attacker input to alter query structure.
mitigation: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements everywhere.
Never concatenate untrusted input into SQL queries.
Apply least-privilege database accounts and suppress verbose DB errors.
